engineering_interpretation: A single novel escape command usually does not erase an already saturated W=8 recurrence state. The strong-loop branch should remain latched after the first escape and continue phase-aware routing until either Submit terminates the task or the recurrence gate clears. In controlled replay, every state reached one of those release conditions within at most five injected successful-path commands.
evidence_boundary: Controlled multistep replay over recorded Qwen/GPT/DeepSeek trajectories. Recorded donor continuation segments supply the injected command sequence; this experiment does not re-execute them in the original Qwen repository state.
